id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_090.pack|cs_: "King Irwin! Thank you for inviting us to this commemorative celebration.
"{var:1}'s birth is a joy for us too. Congratulations!
"Thank you all. Today is a special day for Dundrasil. Please enjoy the celebration at your leisure.
"Sultan, King Gustaf. Welcome to Dundrasil, both of you.
"Ah, King Irwin! It's been too long! Thank you for such a grand welcome! Ha ha ha!!
"...Today's Colloquy of Kings decides Erdrea's future.
"We won't let Gallopolis be left out. Please bear that in mind!
"Four great kingdoms' kings under one roof is unprecedented, as far as I know.
"It shows how important your son, the Luminary, is to us. I look forward to today's meeting.
"Thank you from my heart for coming so far for my son.
"I'll call on you again when the Colloquy begins. I have preparations, so I'll excuse myself.
"Sire! King Carnelian went to the castle courtyard with Lord Robert!"
